title: Bezos quip, Ive design shaped Ferrari's Luce EV, Elkann says
extract: Ferrari chairman John Elkann says a 2016 conversation with Jeff Bezos helped prompt the company to think seriously about an electric Ferrari, while Jony Ive's LoveFrom team spent five years helping shape the Luce.

title: Microsoft brings more AI to PCs as it challenges Apple
extract: Microsoft unveiled a local AI coding model, new agent-security technology and RTX Spark-powered Surface hardware as it pushes more AI processing from the cloud onto Windows PCs.

title: CrowdStrike says China-based suspect used AI tools in South Korean bank attacks
extract: CrowdStrike says a suspected attacker used AI tools while targeting South Korean financial institutions, highlighting the growing use of AI agents in real-world cyber incidents.
